V1⊕V6 = 1: the two pre-workout vectors never run on the same calendar day.
Biotin: disclose 425mcg/day; assay-specific guidance; NO universal 72-hour washout.
S016 is excluded entirely — not his protocol, never was.

cholinergic.framing: Two-sided stack: choline precursors PLUS an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor. Formula-native only, never standalone pills. V1 and V6 never co-occur same day, so the two huperzine doses never stack same-day. Huperzine-A half-life ~10-24h.
cholinergic.state_C: citicoline 250mg + choline 300mg (Pump) + Alpha-GPC 300mg (Pump) + Huperzine-A 50mcg (Pump, evening dose)

cholinergic.huperzine_cautions: slow heart rate/arrhythmia, asthma/COPD, epilepsy/seizure history, significant kidney disease, pregnancy, anticholinergic drugs, prescription Alzheimer drugs — clinician check if any apply

interaction_watchlist: Piperine 15mg on State C days (5mg lunch + 10mg Pump): CYP3A4/P-gp — flag to any prescribing doctor
R-ALA 300mg before 19g-carb V4: shakiness/sweating/confusion post-training = glucose question first
Magnesium ~400mg/day supplemental (night glycinate + Medi-C 105mg + multi): above 350mg supplemental UL (diarrhea endpoint); watch stool, not dangerous
CanPrev Calcium Bis-Glycinate 200mg: timing not in protocol — keep away from beef-liver/iron window, zinc-heavy meals, night magnesium
Huperzine-A cautions: slow heart rate/arrhythmia, asthma/COPD, epilepsy, kidney disease, pregnancy, anticholinergic/memory meds
Post-cholecystectomy: 60-90g fat sittings are the highest-probability GI event; enzymes must match the meal
TestoFX (tongkat/fenugreek, standard doses): higher-scrutiny category — watch BP, mood, sleep; labs tell the truth
No serotonin-syndrome vector (no 5-HTP, St. John's Wort, MAOIs). No frankly contraindicated combos found.
